s18-minimum-number-of-bracket-reversals-.trick: An odd-length brace string cannot balance. Cancel matched pairs; the remaining opens and closes need ceil(count/2) flips each.

s18-count-and-say.trick: Build each term by grouping consecutive equal digits in the previous term and writing count followed by digit.

s18-hashing-in-strings-theory.trick: A polynomial rolling hash combines characters in order. Equal strings hash equally; unequal strings can still collide, so verify matches.

s18-rabin-karp.trick: Slide a fixed-length polynomial hash across the text. Verify characters on a hash match to handle collisions.
s18-rabin-karp.time: O(n + m) expected; O(n · m) with collisions

s18-z-function.trick: Maintain the rightmost substring known to match the prefix; reuse its Z-values and extend only beyond that window.

s18-kmp-algo-lps-pi-array.trick: The LPS array tells how far a partial match can fall back without rechecking text characters.

s18-shortest-palindrome.trick: Find the longest palindromic prefix with a prefix-function scan of s + sentinel + reverse(s), then prepend the remaining reversed suffix.

s18-longest-happy-prefix.trick: The last LPS value is the longest proper prefix that is also a suffix.

s18-count-palindromic-subsequence-in-giv.trick: On equal ends, count both shortened intervals plus the subsequence using both ends. On unequal ends, subtract their overlap.
